factual_methodology.summary: Verified BEA 29 Oct advance Q3 GDP 3.4% vs Q2 2.2%, private final domestic sales 4.9%; September real DPI -0.3%, real PCE rounded 0.0%, PCE inflation 3.6% y/y and saving rate 3.8%. US Treasury official daily par 10Y 4.99/5.05/4.98% for Oct 27/28/29 and 2Y 4.67/4.61%. ECB 29 Oct deposit 2.50%, refinancing 2.65%, marginal 2.90%. BOJ original 30 Oct statement: 8-1 hold at 1.25%; unanimous ETF pace change from ¥330bn to ¥860bn book value, effective January 2027; 43 vs 112 years and 0.1% vs 0.05% of trading value. ICI 29 Oct release: money-market fund assets $7,901.28bn, -$43.29bn weekly. EC October ESI 96.9 and euro-area EEI 98.2; World Bank 28 Oct 2026 commodity outlook +23% aggregate, +32% energy, +10% food; EIA 29 Oct regional gas storage East 913 Bcf (+0.2% y/y) and Mountain 258 Bcf (-9.5% y/y). Reuters/AP contemporaneous completed-session market context confirms concentrated technology selloff.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: Cutoff 30 Oct 2026 05:00 BRT (08:00 UTC); BEA, ECB, EC, Treasury, ICI, EIA and US market observations released/completed Oct 29; BOJ statement released 30 Oct 12:02 JST (00:02 BRT). Monthly vs quarterly, observed vs forecast and book value vs market value are distinguished. BOJ ETF pace acceleration is scheduled for January 2027, not an immediate full liquidation.

evidence_traceability.summary: Twelve numbered bibliography references per language, identical source URLs, with official BEA, Treasury, ECB, BOJ, ICI, European Commission, World Bank and EIA primary evidence and Reuters for market context. Each major number checked against source observation period and instrument; references appear in the end section. Seven H2 headings per edition including bibliography, six analytical sections; mechanism of GDP-income divergence, Treasury financing, AI capex/cash returns, euro-area energy exposure and BOJ balance-sheet normalization is continuous and includes counterevidence and falsifiable monitoring points.

Identical chart numeric series and equivalent period/unit/qualifications; no interpolated, fabricated or dimensionally mixed chart data. Visual count 6 per edition meets brief minimum and stricter depth-script chart threshold.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Institutional English and natural Brazilian Portuguese; numbered source markers in body with full bibliographic URLs at end. Separates observed facts, inferential explanations and conditional scenarios. No product-roadmap commentary, internal QA labels, decorative visuals or investment recommendation; regional interpretation acknowledges missing borrower-level spreads and unobserved portfolio transactions.

translation_parity.summary: Complete EN and PT-BR editions reviewed; all twelve source URLs, three chart numeric series, BOJ votes and ETF amounts, ECB rates, Treasury and BEA observations, forecasts, risk conditions and interpretive limitations correspond.

novelty_against_corpus.summary: Compared public Global Macro 28 and 29 October editions: Oct 28 focused SK hynix memory supply commitments; Oct 29 focused Fed/BoC divergence and Treasury steepening. Oct 30 adds BEA Q3 GDP/September real income divergence, post-earnings equity reaction, ECB 29 Oct hold, EC sentiment and BOJ 30 Oct ETF disposal decision; not merely a date refresh.

counterfactual_review.summary: Robust 4.9% private final domestic sales and positive Russell 2000 performance constrain a broad-recession or universal-AI-capitulation narrative. Higher European employment expectations coexist with lower sentiment; BOJ ETF sales remain conditional and future-dated. Falsifiers include subsequent US real income/consumption, hyperscaler free cash flow and orders, energy costs, credit spreads and actual BOJ disposals.

conflict_security_attribution.summary: Energy and commodity shocks attributed to dated World Bank scenario assumptions; conflict and weather risks are not presented as measured future outcomes or independent verified loss estimates.

validator_contract.summary: Inspected scripts/validate-editorial-depth.mjs, scripts/validate-pipeline.mjs and scripts/lib/visuals.mjs; independently checked candidate-specific thresholds, taxonomy and source paths, EN/PT chart signatures, table/flow/map counts, dates, references and conditional reasoning. GitHub Actions build job for pinned HEAD completed successfully and logged Pipeline validation OK (155 public bundles; 1 unpublished pending; 1 approved unpublished) and Editorial depth validation OK (101 public/revised artifacts). Draft is not included in the default depth validator until approved; local full-repository Node execution unavailable due GitHub clone DNS failure.

contrary_evidence: US private domestic final sales increased 4.9% annualised and Russell 2000 advanced despite Nasdaq losses; the weakness is not uniform.
ECB October employment expectations improved despite lower sentiment; consumer weakness does not prove a broad labour collapse.
BOJ ETF sales are scheduled from January 2027 and may be adjusted or suspended; immediate liquidity impact is not observed.
limitations: GDP is advance quarterly estimate; September income/PCE is a separate monthly vintage and must not be read as quarterly GDP reversal.
No verified borrower-level credit spreads, international investor transaction flows or decomposition of Treasury term premium.
BOJ ETF price effects require observed sales after January 2027; 43-year completion is a mechanical scenario.
World Bank commodity prices are forecasts, not observed spot prices; EIA gas stocks are regional, not global crude data.
Asian intraday price data and later 30 October releases after 05:00 BRT are excluded.

The current source-specific checks do not establish borrower-level credit-spread decomposition or causal identification of equity sellers; Reuters market reaction is context, not proof of investment-flow direction.
ICI, EIA and European Commission source pages update over time; the checked release vintage is 29 October 2026.
The full repository-wide Node validators were confirmed in the pre-approval GitHub Actions build, not rerun locally after approval.
notes: Independent QA approval for the immutable staged revision 1, not publication confirmation. No reports/**, public index, CSS, taxonomy or institutional content changed. Public promotion remains exclusively the publisher's responsibility.
